name: Pennsylvania School for Excellence in the Agricultural Sciences (PSEAS)
org: Penn State College of Agricultural Sciences
what_you_do: A two-week summer school at Penn State where you live on campus. It is for students who like food, farming and nature. Each student is given one of two sessions.
who_can_apply: Pennsylvania residents who are in 11th grade when they apply.
pay_detail: No pay. Free for selected students: tuition, room, board, materials and activities are covered.
duration: 2 weeks. Session 1: June 20 to July 2, 2027. Session 2: July 11 to 24, 2027.
deadline_text: The page says the form is open from November 1 (no year given) and is due Feb 26, 2027. Decisions March 26, 2027.
how_to_apply: Online application, then a 15-minute Zoom interview. Contact PSEAS@psu.edu or 814-867-0383. The page also lists PGSAS@psu.edu, so confirm the address.
notes: No wage is paid. Page lists a contact email in two spellings, so confirm it. As of Nov 4, 2026, the page shows no direct form link, so email or call if you cannot find it.
